run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and NSW (buy.nsw / NSW eTendering) covered best this run, with several open opportunities captured at headline level. Tier 2 government-owned water corporations (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, SA Water) and a rotating sample of universities (Sydney, Adelaide, UTS, UWA, Wollongong) and councils (Inner West, Waverley) were sampled. Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba/Business Network Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths, Coles) was checked but no publicly-visible RFx was found without login. MAJOR LIMITATION: the session's egress proxy blocked ALL direct page fetches (WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for every host, including tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au and even example.com), so no tender detail page or document could be opened. Every tender below was captured from web-search result titles/URLs/snippets only; deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, contacts and most exact dates could not be verified against the source notice and remain pending a detail pass in a future run where direct fetching is available.
gaps: EGRESS BLOCK (organization network policy): WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for every external host tried, including www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au and even example.com. No detail page or tender document could be fetched this run. Only WebSearch (routed through Anthropic, not the egress proxy) was usable, so all tenders are headline-level from search snippets and cannot be confirmed against the originating notice.

Because detail pages were unreachable, deliverables_summary, key_deliverables, scope_of_work, requirements, evaluation_criteria, documents, contacts and several exact publish/closing dates are null/empty and marked pending detail.

Tier 1 states VIC (Buying for Victoria), QLD (QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au), WA (Tenders WA), SA (Tenders SA), TAS (Tenders Tasmania), NT (QTOL) and ACT (Tenders ACT): portals confirmed live via search but no specific new open opportunity with a verifiable ID/date could be captured from snippets this run; deferred.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network Discovery and major-buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Woodside, Woolworths Partner Hub, Coles/Ariba) are registration-gated or invitation-only; no publicly-advertised corporate RFx was visible without a supplier login. Recorded as portals in discovered_sources; no corporate tenders fabricated. Management-consultancy-style invitation-only RFPs remain out of scope.

Two council opportunities surfaced (Inner West Council 'Development Assessment Transformation and AI', closing 14-Aug-2026; Waverley Council waste-collection technology RFT, closing 28-Aug-2026) but both closing dates are already past as at RUN_DATE 2026-08-29, so they were not recorded as open tenders.

University current-tender lists (Sydney, Adelaide) named several live EOIs/RFTs but without captured tender IDs or closing dates from the snippet; only one representative USyd EOI recorded at headline level, the rest deferred.
recommended_seed_additions: Unimarket (cloud procurement platform used by South Australian councils via LGA Procurement) - https://www.lga.sa.gov.au/lgaprocurement
Transport for NSW Internal Expressions of Interest portal - https://eoi-static.prod.cds.transport.nsw.gov.au/
